children: Poland's central bank said on Wednesday that the geopolitical situation, commodity prices and global inflation are key for the consumer price index outlook, after it decided to keep its main interest rate on hold at 3.75%.
Fiscal policy and wage growth remain risks for inflation and further decisions depend on data, it added.
